name: secure-messaging-protocol
description: PQXDH + Double Ratchet secure messaging protocol core (transport-agnostic)

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/transport/proto && cp src/transport/proto/envelope.pb.js src/transport/proto/envelope.pb.d.ts dist/transport/proto/
scripts.proto:generate: pbjs -t static-module -w es6 -o src/transport/proto/envelope.pb.js src/transport/proto/envelope.proto && pbts -o src/transport/proto/envelope.pb.d.ts src/transport/proto/envelope.pb.js
